historical_grouping.note: Existing predictions permit five artifact-safe held-out groups, not 50 new refits. No new model claims are made from unavailable refits.

executable_null_audit.predictor: training-source mean response with no held-out source features

uncertainty.method: multinomial perturbation-source weights applied to unique within-group source pairs; equal group aggregation

train_oof_matching.subset_size: same as that fold's OOF group

claim_rules.artifact_demonstrated: LOO-naive null rho > 0.5 and grouped null absolute rho <= 0.05
claim_rules.unseen_compression_pass: Transformer grouped-rho upper 95% CI < 0.10 and prediction variance ratio < 0.25 and predicted PC1 fraction > truth PC1 fraction
claim_rules.unseen_compression_partial: two of the three PASS conditions
claim_rules.large_gap_pass: matched train minus OOF geometry lower 95% CI > 0.30
claim_rules.large_gap_partial: point gap > 0.30 but lower CI does not exceed 0.30
